findings.headline: Decide this nested createRoot's lifetime.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 parents a root created inside an existing owner to that owner and disposes it with the owner; Solid 1.x kept a nested root alive until its own dispose() was called.
findings.guidance: Determine whether a parent owner can exist when this call runs. If the root must outlive its creator, wrap the call as runWithOwner(null, () => createRoot(...)) to detach it; if it should be disposed with the creator, keep the call and remove any manual dispose bookkeeping that becomes redundant.
